CustomField.description: Loan-to-value ratio: Loan Balance divided by Valuation, expressed as a number out of 100. Returns 0 when Loan Balance or Valuation is empty or zero.
CustomField.formula: IF(OR(ISBLANK(Loan_Balance__c), Loan_Balance__c = 0, ISBLANK(Valuation__c), Valuation__c = 0), 0, Loan_Balance__c / Valuation__c)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically calculated: Loan Balance / Valuation, shown as a percentage.
CustomField.label: Loan to Value
